Class Kanchan

Namespace
Koffing.Waits

Koffing.dll

A wait made up of two tiles in the same non-Zi suit two ranks apart, such as 6 Pin and 8 Pin ("68p").

public Kanchan(IEnumerable<Tile> tiles = null)

Parameters

tiles IEnumerable<Tile>

The Tiles that make up the kanchan.

Remarks

This constructor should not be used in most cases, instead preferring the GetPossible(IEnumerable<Tile>) and GetPossibleForTile(Tile, IEnumerable<Tile>) static helper functions in this class to maintain the semantic meaning of a kanchan.
